The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the verses mirrors the staccato rhythm of traffic lights and subway doors, while the raw, unfiltered narratives of the lyrics reflect the diverse, often untold stories of the city's inhabitants. The heavy bass lines resonate like the deep hum of the city's infrastructure, grounding the experience in a tangible, pulsating reality. This auditory layer aims to immerse visitors in the visceral experience of urban existence, where every beat and bar contributes to the complex symphony of metropolitan life.
